notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary (Update)
notes.notes:
Time to celebrate the 2nd anniversary of the game's release 2 years ago (21 January 2021). With new content! A new level (16) just dropped! It's a mashup mix of the last 2 years. Big enough to enjoy with up to 4 players.

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
A new level (14) has been added to the game. Back to school! Rock your way through geography class and go down in history.


[previewyoutube=JsLmaeLjlIs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
This update brings a new level where you break into an industrial site at night.

And a new mode where you can create your own list by hiding 9 eggs yourself.
You can hide eggs in most of the levels. 
The game generates a “key” (a short text/sentence) that can be shared with others. Your friends can enter your "key" to play the level you created.

[list]
[*] Level 11 has been made easier
[*] It is now possible to reverse the mouse movement (inverting x, y)
[*] Bob's neck has been fixed (level 3)
[/list]

[previewyoutube=HsxOQpNTNB4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.notes:
This update brings two (2) new cool levels.

New office level:
You planned to break into the office complex at night. You thought it should be empty by this time. But a cruel boss forces his employees to work around the clock. So be ready for company!

New construction site level:
You need new tools for your garden, why not just steal them from a nearby construction site?

This update also includes a FOV slider inside the settings.

notes.title: Easter update
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Easter![/b]
This update brings two new levels (level 10 and a bonus Easter level).

Level 10 features the first 3-story house with 2 patrolling homeowners. The AIs not only run around, but instead use the toilet, sit on the couch, look into the fridge, or work on the computer.

The Easter bonus level takes you to a small park with several gardens nearby. You have to break into each garden to get 9 Easter eggs (colored eggs).

Both levels can be played with your friends through the multiplayer mode.

This update also made some changes to Level 2:
[list]
[*] You can now blind the AI with your flashlight
[*] The pattern of the AI has been changed
[*] AI stands longer in one position
[*] AI can now sit on the couch
[*] AI loses the player faster
[/list]

notes.title: February 20th update
notes.notes:
Some single-player levels (all except 3 and 4) can now be played online with other players! These levels can be hosted through the multiplayer menu. All levels can be played with up to 4 players, but some levels may be too small.
Recommended for up to 4 players: level 6, 8, and undead.
Recommended for 2 players: Level 1, 2, 5, 7, 9, and Santa.

Also:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash in the multiplayer menu
[*]Shorter range for the homeowner
[*]The homeowner can no longer climb ladders
[*]Bob from level 3 now turns his head towards the player
[*]New way to distract the homeowner/shopkeeper
[*]A setting to control mouse sensitivity has been added
[*]Corrected some Spanish, French, and Portuguese translations
[*]Added translations for "Level"
[*]Removed a lag when climbing a ladder or jumping through a window
[*]Spectators can now fly through closed (garage) doors and climbable windows
[/list]
